metadata.reference: k_eff, log[:,26]; contact from normal force and tissue gain
metadata.cases: corrected_comparison.cases(); observations recorded once per source; every method sees identical rows and no truth
metadata.segments: plateau, transition: no scene event; rate of ln k_eff (0.2 s boxcar) below .05/s away from transitions, above .2/s; between them unassigned. event: every tick in [start, end+.3]; event_only and event_transition split it by whether the reference is also changing.
metadata.channels: raw: estimator output on ticks where it produced a value, nothing held. k_good: the stiffness the controller uses at each tick, held by construction; Huber-D4, D4 and P5 apply their acceptance gates and CENTRE 1.054, the others use the estimate directly. Memory methods: raw is the filter output.
metadata.rates: valid: raw finite and positive; accepted: per host rule, equal to valid for methods without gates; usable: both; false_update: |ln(k/k_eff)|>ln1.2 among ticks that update k_good; low_update: its low side; coverage: |err|<=2 sigma among those ticks.
metadata.tracking: Transitions by family. no_event: all scenes, |d ln k|>=.3, not overlapping an event. core_scenes: its A, A_slow_thin, A+B part. no_event_small: .15<=|d ln k|<.3. event_coupled: all scenes, |d ln k|>=.3, overlapping an event. Events after contact loss are kept and flagged. Lag on pre-transition-debiased error, needing data on half the interval; under_raw = max(0, -min err), never negative; over_raw the high side. Recovery within ln1.2 for .2 s from the transition end. Lag and recovery medians are Kaplan-Meier: reaching the bound, not recovering in 2 s and episode end are right-censored, not capped values. None means the median lies beyond the censoring horizon.
metadata.limits: Open-loop replay: an estimator does not influence the trajectory it sees. Configurations frozen, selected before the H correction. Six cases per scene, descriptive only. Timings are Python prototype under parallel workers, not real-time evidence.
